d:
A scarecrow species with a burlap sack head and long, spindly limbs made of rotting wood and twine. Empty, glowing orange eyes recessed deep within a stitched mouth. A skeletal, towering build with unnaturally long fingers. Wears tattered, charcoal gray rags and a weathered straw hat. Features long, sharp wooden claws on each hand and a jagged, wooden spine.
BODY COLOR: weathered burlap brown
